get.summary: Retrieves detailed information about a specific staff member.
get.description:
Returns the complete staff profile including role, permissions, and work locations.
This information is used for authentication, authorization, and service assignment.

Returns NOT_FOUND if the staff ID doesn't exist.
Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier of the staff member to retrieve
Required. Format: "stf_" followed by random characters

post.summary: Lists staff members matching the specified criteria.
post.description:
Results are paginated and filtered by company ID. This method is typically used
for staff management, scheduling, and reporting purposes.

Returns an empty list if no staff members match the criteria.
Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request message for listing staff members.

pagination.title:
Pagination parameters for the request
Required. Defines page size and token for continuation

companyId.title:
ID of the company to list staff members for
Required. Must be a valid company ID

v1ListStaffsRequest.description: Request message for listing staff members.

nextPageToken.title:
Token for retrieving the next page of results
Empty if there are no more results

staffs.title:
List of staff members matching the request criteria
May be empty if no staff members match

v1ListStaffsResponse.description: Response message for listing staff members.

pageSize.title:
integer, Number of items to return per page.
Minimum: 1, Maximum: 500

pageToken.description:
string, Token for retrieving the next page.
Obtained from the previous page's response.
Leave empty for the first page.

v1Pagination.description:
The pagination object provides a standardized way to handle paginated results
across all API endpoints. It supports both cursor-based and offset-based
pagination, with configurable page sizes and sorting options. This ensures
consistent and efficient data retrieval for large result sets.

v1Permission.description:
Permission represents a specific action that can be performed in the system.
Permissions are grouped into roles and assigned to staff members.

 - PERMISSION_UNSPECIFIED: Unknown or invalid permission
Should not be used when assigning permissions

id.title:
Unique identifier for the role
Format: "rol_" followed by random characters

name.title:
Display name of the role
Example: "Administrator", "Groomer", "Receptionist"

permissions.title:
List of permissions granted to this role
Determines what actions can be performed

v1Role.description:
Role defines a set of permissions and capabilities assigned to staff members.
Roles help manage access control and determine what actions staff can perform.

id.title:
Unique identifier for the staff member
Format: "stf_" followed by random characters

avatar.title:
URL to the staff member's profile picture
Optional. Must be a valid HTTPS URL

phone.title:
Staff member's phone number
Format: E.164 format (e.g., +12125551234)

email.title:
Staff member's email address
Format: Must be a valid email address

role.title:
Staff member's role and associated permissions
Determines what actions they can perform in the system

hiredTime.title:
When this staff member was hired
Used for reporting and service history

workingBusinessIds.title:
IDs of business locations where this staff member works
Staff can only be assigned to appointments at these locations

mobileVanId.title:
ID of the mobile van assigned to this staff member
Only applicable for mobile service providers

companyId.title:
ID of the company this staff member belongs to
Used for access control and data segregation

deleted.title:
Indicates whether this staff member has been soft deleted
If true, the staff member is no longer active but their data is retained
for historical records and reporting purposes

v1Staff.description:
Staff represents an employee or contractor who provides services in your business.
Staff members can be assigned to appointments, manage customer relationships,
and perform various administrative tasks based on their role and permissions.
